stubs.pretends: backgroundBuild()/backgroundActivationSteps() and buildProjectContext({ projectWrites: 'none' }) exist without a production caller: startServer still builds every project through activatingBuild on its first request; U4a's background build queue calls backgroundBuild and routes «needs activation» to activatingBuild on the first request
stubs.why: U3 owns the no-write init steps and their mode; the queue that runs them after listen is U4a's goal
stubs.closedHow: startServer builds through ProjectContextCache(activatingBuild(...), { background: backgroundBuild(registry, (p, mode) => buildContext(p, mode.projectWrites)) }) and calls cache.start(...) after listenOrExit; a request to a project in «needs activation» runs activatingBuild (src/server/index.ts, src/server/workspace/context-cache.ts)
